combo_label: Farms & Farming × Sewing & Knitting × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Golden grain ground into the white flour of a loaf
Yard bird that scratches for grit and leaves a warm egg in her nest box
Cut shapes of cloth laid on a background and secured all round the edge
A tap of the sword on each shoulder raised a man to this mounted rank
Ring the walls, cut the roads, then wait: hunger does the rest
Ducks, geese and turkeys among them, all kept for eggs and the table
Fold pressed into a fabric to give fullness, as down a school skirt
Any spun strand wound into a ball, be it wool, cotton or acrylic
Two rows of teeth married up by a sliding tab, prone to jamming on a jacket
Body of soldiers left behind to hold a place against attack
